chronology: Additional development hypothesis justified by an outcome-blind source audit of the one-pass ladder. Declared after thirteen prior development outcomes, before any recurrence-driver implementation or historical outcome. This is not unseen validation or confirmation.

policy.confirmed_plus_pending_lifetime_recovery: 3 * original actual all-in entry seed * sum(frozen profile seed multiples)
policy.thresholds_and_seed: Preserve original parent entry anchor, actual initial all-in seed, assigned profile and original BASE_ENTRY lot. No profit or equity resizing.
policy.priority: Original next unused price-eligible sequential rung wins even if its admission fails. Otherwise select deepest eligible renewed rung. No fallback after selected proposal failure; at most one proposal per parent per completed bar.
policy.receipt_proof: Exact prior episode RECOVERY lots completely disposed, each strictly net-positive after actual charged buy/sell fees, exact owner settlement and explicit same-owner partial-release proof, zero pending parent commitments, original base lot still active.
policy.price_proof: After confirmation, observed completed close ABOVE original rung threshold, then a distinct later completed close AT/BELOW. No same-bar reset and crossing, intrabar or future-price evidence.
policy.native_protection: Renewal requires no armed native profit floor and preserves existing profit-state memory at confirmed renewed fill. Original first-pass behavior stays byte-equivalent to v2, including its existing profit policy.
policy.funding: Existing exact VCAP owner cash, original rung maximum, native recovery/tranche evidence, enabled recovery-quality gate, pending holds, strict25% pretrade-equity cash target,20%/$40 hard floor,5% pair cap, minima and immediate-next-open FOK capacity. No PRODUCTIVE-to-VCAP principal transfer or hypothetical proceeds.
policy.strict_arithmetic: Exact rational confirmed gross+fee turnover and pending authorization, no widened cap tolerance. Preserve original native first-pass fill arithmetic; conservatively reduce renewed requested budgets before admission if rounding would exceed a ceiling.

admission: New immutable v4 driver and tests; independent source-bound synthetic/adversarial receipt proof and neutral generated-body equivalence. Neutral full-combination historical control must pass independent full-path financial/owner audits and exactly match v2 before recurrence candidates run. All corresponding v2 comparison outcomes must be finalized and independently audited. Do not edit any active earlier driver or original protocol.
reporting: Serialize immutable episode IDs/lots/order receipts, original progression, exact confirmed/pending turnover, disposal and release proof, completed-bar reset/crossing, denials, retired parent and manifest-bound terminal checkpoint. Report known/UNKNOWN categories, original versus renewed confirmed fills, actual net lot results, total account PnL/open losses, cash owners, occupancy and terminal sensitivities.
selection_gate: Original positive whole-account marked PnL, independent accounting PASS and drawdown no worse than exact primary owner/cost control remain required. Hypothetical terminal-exit costs also reported. Keep original maximum two finalists/eight stresses and six genuinely unseen evaluations; do not treat this retrospective supplement as fresh evidence.
not_included: This full combination keeps the same selector/directional/quality/ladder/redeployment flags. Market-regime, weekly-refresh, rotation, actual hedges and full durable production lifecycle are not silently included. No private account, live order, merge or deployment authority is introduced.
